despite dropping at least four chances. USA's new ball pair of Phillip and Netravalkar 
bowled superbly in the Powerplay to pin West Indies down at 14 for 2. Charles and Hope 
then constructed a century stand to put USA in control. Steven Taylor was the catalyst 
to bring USA back into the match with his spell of offspin and ended with 3 for 53 in 
eight overs, inducing some poor shots to lure West Indies into throwing away their 
wickets. Netravalkar and Phillip then come back at the death and have given USA some 
faint hope of chasing this down by wiping out the tail short of 300. It could have been
